rationale: Species is a nominal category.
Island is a nominal location category.
Bill length is a continuous measurement.
Bill depth is a continuous measurement.
Flipper length is a measured quantity.
Body mass is a measured quantity.
Sex is represented as a nominal category.
Year is an ordered temporal field.
UCI defines dteday as a date.
Season is category-coded; either categorical or ordinal is acceptable for visualization generation.
Holiday is a binary indicator.
Weekday codes identify nominal day categories.
Working day is a binary indicator.
Weather situation is category-coded and also has an interpretable severity ordering.
Temperature is a continuous measurement.
Feeling temperature is continuous.
Normalized humidity is continuous.
Normalized wind speed is continuous.
Total rentals is a numeric count; either numeric treatment is acceptable.
Passenger class is a three-level ordered category encoded numerically.
Survival status is a binary 0/1 outcome.
Sex is a nominal category.
Age is measured in years and includes fractional ages for some infants.
SibSp is a genuine count of siblings/spouses aboard, not a category code.
Parch is a genuine count of parents/children aboard, not a category code.
Fare is a continuous monetary quantity.
Embarkation port is a nominal category.
Age is an integer-valued measurement that is normally treated as a continuous numeric feature for exploratory analysis.
Job is a nominal occupation category.
Marital status is categorical.
UCI describes education as categorical, though an ordinal interpretation is also defensible.
Credit default is represented as yes/no.
Average yearly balance is a numeric monetary quantity.
Housing-loan status is represented as yes/no.
Personal-loan status is represented as yes/no.
Contact communication type is categorical.
Day of month is a discrete calendar field. Temporal or ordered-discrete treatment is reasonable within Visift's current taxonomy.
Month is a cyclical calendar field encoded with month abbreviations.
Campaign is a count of contacts; both discrete and general numeric treatment preserve the intended visualization family.
Pdays is an integer count of elapsed days, with -1 indicating no previous contact.
Previous is an integer count of prior campaign contacts.
Previous campaign outcome is categorical.
The target records term-deposit subscription as yes/no.
